about_the_game:
Jitter turns Twitch streams into fully interactive, Twitch-integrated gaming experiences — where thousands of players can jump in at the same time!

Viewers don't just watch, they play, with the ability to control the action right from Twitch chat. Whether it's joining the game directly or influencing gameplay through real-time chat commands, Jitter creates massive-scale experiences that keep everyone engaged.

In the main game mode, Chasers race down a chaotic obstacle course, dodging traps and pitfalls to reach the Defender in the castle, but beware, they have powers to try stop you. Each round resets, and the winning catcher can become the next defender if the Twitch streamer host selects them.

👑 Host Features:

Twitch Streamer World Hosting: Streamers create and manage their own game worlds.

Game Setup Control Panel: Streamers start matches and set up the game.

Defender Powers Control Panel: Streamers can buff/nerf defender abilities to fit their audience.

🕹️ Player Features:

Full directional movement with jump and double jump.

Click-to-zoom and fire controls.

In-game voice and text chat for team coordination and social play.

📺 Twitch Integration:

Viewer Voting: Twitch chat votes for the defender's next power using Twitch Polls.

Emote-Powered Chaos: Viewers spam emotes in chat to blow up bridges in real-time.

Jitter isn't just a game—it's an interactive stream, community challenge, and wild race all in one. Get ready to play, watch, and create unforgettable moments together!
